narrative.summary: Nauru has no AI strategy, AI law or AI guidance. Its only AI-specific rule is section 54 of the Naoero Cybersecurity Act 2026, in force since 17 September 2026, which tasks the new Naoero Cybersecurity Authority with assessing AI-related cyber risks and allows it to issue guidance. The National Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030 does not mention AI, and Nauru has no general data protection law.
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 13 October 2026 from the official legislation portal (RONLAW), including its gazettes, and the government website; all units were reached. Any AI security guidance the new cybersecurity authority issues is tracked as a lead.

instruments.current_status: Act No. 38 of 2026, certified by the Speaker on 17 September 2026 (notified in Government Gazette Extraordinary No. 319, G.N. No. 943/2026, 17 September 2026). Effective date computed from s.2 (commences on the date it is certified by the Speaker): in force 17 September 2026. No amendments listed in the consolidated text (RONLAW Service 6).
instruments.summary: Nauru's first cybersecurity framework law: it establishes the Naoero Cybersecurity Authority, a Cybersecurity Advisory Council and a national CERT, provides for a National Cybersecurity Strategy and Roadmap, and sets designation, incident-reporting, audit and penalty rules for critical information infrastructure and public digital systems. Section 54 requires the Authority to monitor and assess cybersecurity risks of emerging technologies, expressly including artificial intelligence, and empowers it to issue guidelines, advisories, standards or recommendations on their secure use and management. Part 8 obliges public bodies, CII operators and prescribed entities to protect personal data and notify data breaches.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Only AI-specific statutory provision found in Nauru law: s.54 gives the Naoero Cybersecurity Authority a mandate to assess AI-related cyber risks and issue AI security guidance.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Nauru's legislation portal, the government website, departments and regulators were searched, and all were reached. One law with an AI provision, the Naoero Cybersecurity Act 2026, was found; no AI law, AI bill or data protection law was found, and there was no AI material in any other category. A national cybersecurity roadmap has no official text online and remains to be checked.
coverage_audit.technical_note: Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-13, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. ronlaw.gov.nr searched via its own full-text endpoint (POST /api/pdf/search); one gazette issue downloaded (Gazette Extraordinary 319/2026, G.N. 943/2026). Act published and effective 2026-09-17 (certification; s.2 commences on certification). data-privacy category dropped at merge (Part 8 breach duties in a cybersecurity act; not a data protection law). 37 gazette AI hits are trademark notices. Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030 read: no AI, undated (lead). Budget AI-in-schools pilot internal (lead). Convention 108: not a party. Units covered: Law: RONLAW (Republic of Nauru legislation portal: acts, subsidiary laws, bills, gazettes) full-text searched via its own search API for AI and related terms. One Act with an explicit AI provision found (Naoero Cybersecurity Act 2026, s.54) and its certification gazette notice read. No AI law, AI bill, deepfake offence, automated-decision rule or comprehensive data protection law. Gazette AI hits are all trademark registration notices (out of scope). Only gazette issues 319/2026 downloaded.; Government: nauru.gov.nr (Government Information Office, Department of Telecommunications) reviewed via site map: no national AI strategy, AI policy or public-sector AI guideline. National Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030 read in full: no AI content (lead). Searched, nothing else found.; Ministries: Education (only an AI pilot budget line in the 2026-27 budget speech; lead), health, justice, finance, foreign affairs: no AI documents found on nauru.gov.nr or RONLAW. Most departments have no own website. Searched, nothing found.; Regulators: No data protection authority exists (no data protection law). Naoero Cybersecurity Authority newly established under the 2026 Act; no AI guidance yet and no website found. Cyber Security Awareness Team pages hold only RFC 2350 and committee ToR (no AI). Virtual asset authority (Command Ridge Virtual Asset Authority Act 2025) has an emerging-technologies sandbox for virtual assets only (out of scope). No financial, telecom or competition regulator AI documents found. Searched, nothing found.. Not reached: none. leads.title: Nauru National Digital Transformation Strategy 2025 - 2030
leads.issuing_authority: Government of the Republic of Nauru (Minister for Information & Communications Technology; Department of Telecommunications)
leads.note: Official document on nauru.gov.nr (https://www.nauru.gov.nr/media/204028/nndts_final_version_2025.pdf, linked from the Department of Telecommunications 'Digital Transformation Strategy' page). Full 52-page text read 2026-10-13: it contains no reference to artificial intelligence (no AI pillar), so it fails the §1 scope test; it plans data protection/privacy, cybersecurity and e-governance legislation and a National Cybersecurity Framework. Also no stated publication date in the document or on the page. Re-check if a revised edition adds AI.
